pages.text: Type blocks are red slabs. Each is crafted from a type base and an item, in any shape:

$(li)BOOLEAN: redstone torch$(li)INTEGER: sand$(li)FLOAT: red sand$(li)CHAR: oak plank$(li)STRING: string$(li)ARRAY: barrel$(li)HASH: chest$(li)STRUCT: scaffolding$(li)TIME: clock$(li)ERROR: campfire$(br2)VARIABLE is a type base and a bone block. CONSTANT is a type base and three bones.
